# 1_50

<span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted">complete</span> <span class="tada-chip tada-chip--muted" title="Locked flights are released from the window; trained and scored in that environment">release MDP</span>

**What changed:** From scratch in the release MDP: locked flights released from the window (±30 s), bracket paid at release, flat deviation potential, feasible-only training by redraw at reset (≤ 650 s early), ±30 s bracket worth 4. Recipe arm D (10 flights to 2.5M, then 20 to 10M), LR 3e-4 to 3e-5, seed 1.

!!! note "Release MDP"
    This model trained in the release MDP, unlike the champion and every model before `1_49`: after each step the front of the landing queue is released once a flight is locked (predicted within 30 s of its target and in no predicted conflict). A released flight leaves the window and can no longer be cleared. It is scored in the same environment, on the same seeds and with the same metrics, so its numbers measure landings in the same scenarios, but under that extra constraint on the agent.

!!! info "About this run"
    19 of its 20 losses of separation are on the 49 validation seeds with a flight more than 650 s early (validation_seed_capacity.csv). On the 51 feasible seeds it solves 33 and hard-solves 21 with 1 loss, against 1_38&#x27;s 34, 15 and 0 (hard-solved 12 gained, 6 lost, p = 0.24). So it is on par with 1_38 on feasible 20-flight streams, and behind on the feasible stitched 40-flight streams it never trained on: on test51 it solves 16 against 25 (3 gained, 12 lost, p = 0.035), hard-solves as many (5 each) and loses 2. Arm D trains on 10- and 20-flight streams only; 1_38 trained on stitched 2×20 streams to the end. Trained with a reward flaw since fixed (code commit 618a073): with pay at release, a flight&#x27;s bracket paid at release was kept even when the episode then ended in a loss of separation, so a bust cost less than the objective says. Runs after that commit take the release payments of flights still airborne back on a bust. This is a plausible contributor to its losses on over-capacity seeds, not a proven one.

## Reproduce

```bash
recipes/windowed_from_scratch.sh 1 D --hard-bracket --release-locked --pay-at-release --flat-deviation --train-max-early-s 650 --run-suffix scratch_d_release_s1

# score: 20-flight and stitched 2x20, 10 attempts, lookahead (100 validation seeds)
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_50_scratch_d_release_s1/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --attempts 9
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_50_scratch_d_release_s1/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --segments 2 --gap 120 900
TADA_SEQUENCE_OBS=1 TADA_MAX_PICKS=2 python analysis/score_windowed.py --models experiments/atc_run_1_50_scratch_d_release_s1/final_model.zip --seeds 100 --lookahead 4
```
